done_when: forge close runs the repo's test command on the machine it runs on and gives the reviewer the result, listing what passed and what was skipped with the reason; the review brief says a skipped test that the close run passed is not a missing test, and that for a pure deletion a test showing the old input is now refused is enough; tests run forge close with a test command that passes and one that skips

findings.body: The new `-v` default applies only when Forge creates a new Go repo. Existing Forge repos retain the previous `go test ./...` value in forge.toml, and adoption copies the supplied `--test` command unchanged (`src/forge/init.py:283`). The close runner executes that stored command as-is (`src/forge/review.py:237`). As established by the earlier review, `go test ./...` reports only a passing package summary, so close still cannot tell the reviewer which tests skipped or why. This persisted-config path is new evidence beyond the ruling about the new init default.
findings.title: Not done: existing Go repos still hide skipped tests

findings.body: The coordinator accepted the new init assertion plus the Go-style output test as proof for newly created repos. Neither test covers the distinct persisted-config case: test 4 feeds Forge canned verbose output, while this test checks only the command written by a fresh init. A forge close test with the previously generated `go test ./...` configuration is needed to fail when its skipped test and reason never reach the brief.
findings.title: Not done: a close test covers skipped Go tests in existing repos

findings.body: This still removes the middle of selected output once it exceeds 80 lines. A pytest `-rs` run with many skipped tests can retain the final skip count while dropping individual skip entries and their reasons. The reviewer then lacks the promised reason for each omitted skip.
findings.title: Preserve skip reasons beyond the 80-line cap

why: Reviewers can't see tests that only run outside the worker's sandbox, such as database tests, so every database change is flagged as untested even when those tests pass
